{"predictors": [
{"name": "Revenue Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of revenue from different business segments over the past 3 years, using Compustat segment data", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated revenue streams may be more vulnerable to disruptions in their core business, leading to higher expected returns. This concentration can be a proxy for underlying business risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Acceleration", "construction": "Compute the difference between the 3-year and 1-year growth rates of total employees, using Compustat employee data", "rationale": "Rapidly accelerating employee growth may signal over-expansion or inefficient scaling, leading to higher expected returns as investors demand compensation for potential future restructuring. This acceleration can indicate management's ability to adapt to growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Dependence", "construction": "Estimate the fraction of cost of goods sold accounted for by the firm's top 5 suppliers, using Compustat supplier data and industry reports", "rationale": "Firms heavily dependent on a few key suppliers may face higher supply chain risks, such as price increases or delivery disruptions, leading to higher expected returns. This dependence can be a proxy for operational risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Obsolescence", "construction": "Calculate the fraction of patents that are more than 10 years old, using US Patent and Trademark Office data and firm patent filings", "rationale": "Firms with a high proportion of obsolete patents may be at risk of technological disruption, leading to higher expected returns as investors demand compensation for potential future losses. This obsolescence can indicate a firm's ability to innovate.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration by Region", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl index of sales by geographic region, using Compustat geographic segment data", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated sales in a few regions may be more vulnerable to regional economic downturns, leading to higher expected returns. This concentration can be a proxy for geographic risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of inventory turnover over the past 5 years, using Compustat inventory and cost of goods sold data", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile inventory turnover may face operational risks, such as inventory obsolescence or supply chain disruptions, leading to higher expected returns. This volatility can indicate a firm's ability to manage working capital.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "R&D Intensity Persistence", "construction": "Compute the 3-year average R&D intensity (R&D expense as a fraction of sales) and compare it to the 1-year average, using Compustat R&D data", "rationale": "Firms with persistent R&D intensity may be more likely to generate future growth opportunities, leading to higher expected returns. This persistence can indicate a firm's commitment to innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of accounts payable days over the past 5 years, using Compustat accounts payable and cost of goods sold data", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile accounts payable days may face operational risks, such as supply chain disruptions or cash flow management issues, leading to higher expected returns. This volatility can indicate a firm's ability to manage working capital.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Estimate the present value of potential environmental liabilities, using EPA data and firm environmental reports", "rationale": "Firms with significant environmental liabilities may face higher expected returns as investors demand compensation for potential future cleanup costs or regulatory risks. This liability can be a proxy for environmental risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Overcommitment", "construction": "Calculate the average number of board seats held by each board member, using proxy statements and board member biographies", "rationale": "Firms with overcommitted board members may face governance risks, such as decreased monitoring or advice, leading to higher expected returns. This overcommitment can indicate a firm's ability to attract and retain talented directors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
